title: 2101 Prairie, the 21st Street corner house, is built
items: 2101 Prairie, on the corner of 21st Street, now stands as a full house in place of its draft. Its plan comes from the 1911 map: a two-and-a-half-storey brick house 22 m deep, two painted frame bays along 21st Street, a two-storey frame bay on its south side and a long brick range behind. No picture of it is known, so the red brick front, hooded windows, bracketed cornice, slate roof with its dormer and the stoop are a careful best guess, and the house's card says so.
